[[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] '''Lom Melams''' served in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Melams was the commander of the [[DVL-181]], an Alliance outpost that was located on a swampy [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. He was the highest ranking Alliance officer in the region and had several [[Alliance Special Operations/Legends|Alliance Special Operations]] teams under his command.<ref name="HS" />

==Personality==
Melams was dedicated to the Alliance. He expected success from those he commanded and was intolerant of incompetence, so became very angry and unhappy when people failed him.<ref name="HS" />
